The '''First Alderaan Support Division''' was a division within the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The division was based on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and focused on aiding the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] secure the throne in the [[Alderaan Civil War|bloody planetary civil war]].
